tema.pista: Click an element on the canvas to edit it.
tema.nombre.ayuda: How it appears in the theme list.
tema.autor.ayuda: If you share the theme, who made it. A nickname is fine.
tema.orientacion.ayuda: How your display is placed. If something doesn't fit after turning it, it's moved back inside.
tema.fondo.color.ayuda: Shown where there's no background image.
tema.fondo.imagen.ayuda: Fills the whole screen; if its shape is different, the sides are cropped.
